An '''electronic scale''' was a piece of scientific equipment. [[Scientist/Legends|Science]] team [[MS-133]] used an electronic scale during the [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] dig on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aaris III]] along with other equipment including a [[Hand scanner/Legends|hand scanner]] and a [[fine particle blower]].
